Type: table
Name: Strathwood Signature Tavolara Teak Coffee Table
Colors: Distressed Finish
Materials: Wood
The Strathwood Tavolara coffee table is crafted of high-quality teak hardwood Designed for outdoor use, teak wood will naturally weather to a silver-grey over time Features a tightly slatted table top with a circular design on the sides Mortise-and-tenon joint construction eases required assembly Table measures 43-1/4 inches long by 23-1/2 inches wide by 17-3/4 inches high; chairs not included
